name: oval
description: A single-player 3D president simulator: govern a modern nation while keeping your health, family and sanity intact.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradle --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.godot:test: ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --import >/dev/null && ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --script godot/tests/parity.gd && ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --quit-after 900 --script godot/tests/events_smoke.gd && ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --quit-after 1200 --script godot/tests/epilogue_smoke.gd && ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --quit-after 8000 --script godot/tests/scenes_smoke.gd && ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --quit-after 900 --script godot/tests/oval_office_smoke.gd && ${GODOT:-godot4} --headless --path . --quit-after 900 --script godot/tests/cabinet_room_smoke.gd
